contexts.text: Mountains = the Lord, and His holy heavenly things, on which account the Lord promulgated the Law from Mount Sinai. AC 6435:12.
When the Lord appeared... in Mount Sinai, it was a vision...
Why the Israelites were not allowed to approach Mount Sinai. AC 8797:3.
Why He so appeared on Mount Sinai.
Sinai (), from the Law promulgated there, = good and the derivative truth.
The good from which is truth is the good with the spiritual man after regeneration; for he then does good from affection... This good is signified by Sinai.
Mount Sinai = the good in which is truth.
They came to the Wilderness of Sinai () = a state of good in which the truths of faith are to be implanted... Sinai = the truths themselves.

Mount Sinai, in the supreme sense, = Divine truth from Divine good; mount, Divine good; and Sinai, Divine truth: in the internal sense, it = the truth of faith from good; here, the truth of faith to be implanted in good, because the Law had not yet been promulgated from it. Explained, Illustrated.
Sinai () = the truths of faith in the complex.
Upon Mount Sinai () = into the good in which truth is to be implanted.

Mount Sinai, in special, = Heaven, out of which truths flow from the Lord. Hence the descent of Jehovah upon that mountain = His presence in Heaven. And, as Mount Sinai = Heaven, in which is the Lord, it also = the Divine good united to Divine truth there. AC 8818.
The whole of Mount Sinai smoked () = the appearing of heavenly good in the greatest obscurity. Explained.
Mount Sinai = Heaven.
Jehovah descended upon Mount Sinai () = the presence of the Lord in Heaven.
To the head of the Mount = in the Inmost Heaven. AC 8830.
The people cannot ascend to Mount Sinai () = that those of the Spiritual Kingdom cannot elevate themselves to the Celestial Kingdom. Mount Sinai = the Celestial Kingdom. Explained.
The Mount, here Mount Sinai, = the Divine good united to the Divine truth in Heaven. AC 9388:end.
Mount Sinai is here () called heaven.
This is why Mount Sinai = Heaven, whence is Divine truth.
Mount Sinai = the Law, or Divine truth, and the Word such as it is in Heaven; thus also Heaven.
Mount Sinai = the Word which is from the Lord, thus in which is the Lord; consequently also Heaven. Explained.
Mount Sinai, here called the mount of God () = the Law, or the Divine truth which is from the Lord, thus the Word such as it is in Heaven; consequently Heaven.
That Mount Sinai = the Law, or the Divine truth proceeding from the Lord's Divine good, thus the Word; and, in the supreme sense, the Lord. Illustrated.

Mount Sinai = the Law, or the Divine truth proceeding from the Lord, thus the Word. Its summit, where was Jehovah, = the inmost of the Law, or Word; the rest of the mount below the summit = the internal of the Law, or Word, such as it is in Heaven; and those parts below the mount, where were the elders and people, = the external of the Law, or Word, which is its external sense.
The glory of Jehovah abode upon Mount Sinai () = the interiors of the Word of the Lord in Heaven.
Mount Sinai = Heaven where is Divine truth in light.
Mount Sinai = Heaven.
Mount Sinai = Heaven whence is Divine truth. AC 10450.
Mount Sinai = Heaven as to Divine truth.
Mount Sinai = Divine truth.
Be ready for the morning, and thou shalt ascend to Mount Sinai () = a new rise of the revelation of Divine truth. Mount Sinai = Heaven whence is Divine truth; thus whence is revelation.
Thou shalt stand to Me there upon the head of the Mount () = from the Inmost Heaven where is the Divine love. Mount Sinai = Heaven whence is revelation. AC 10607.
The more lofty mountain in the middle (of Horeb) was called Mount Sinai. Hence... the internal of Heaven is signified by Mount Sinai. (See Horeb.)
Why Jehovah descended upon the summit of Mount Sinai. Explained.
As Moses descended from Mount Sinai () = the influx of the internal into the external of the Word, the Church, and worship.
Mount Sinai = Heaven where the Lord is, and whence is the Law, or Word.
Mentioned.
Sinai = Heaven where is the Lord, from whom is Divine truth, or from whom is the Law in a narrow and a wide sense.
Sinai = Heaven where and whence is Divine truth. Therefore it is said: Sinai in the Sanctuary ().
As a mountain = the good of love... Jehovah descended upon Mount Sinai, and promulgated the Law, ... Hence Sinai, in the Word, = Divine truth from Divine good.
Mount Sinai = Heaven whence is Divine truth.
